Marcus: Quick ask — Growth needs to buy a perpetual license + migration tool from QuietMetrics. Total $9,750. Can we fast-track?
Anya: Paste vendor + short biz case and security will need to confirm data scope.
Marcus: Vendor: QuietMetrics Inc. Biz case: Automate trial cohort reporting, frees ~6 engineer days/month, shortens trial-to-conversion by ~2 days.
Samir: I'll get W9 and vendor contact.
Elaine: Security: need app review. If they confirm no PII and provide a test account we can expedite (3-5 business days -> faster).
Marcus: Submitted PO exception form (PO-EXC-2026-45) with contact lisa@quietmetrics.com.
Procurement: Received. Because amount < $10k we can fast-track pending security sign-off and manager-level delegated approval.
Marcus: Growth tagged cost center GROWTH-TRIALS; ongoing maintenance estimated <$1k/yr.
Samir: W9 uploaded and invoice attached. Banking details pending.
Elaine: Security expedited approval granted — no PII, read-only dashboards only.
Jordan: Manager approval granted.
Procurement: PO issued PO-2026-9981. Please ensure vendor references PO on invoice for the next AP run.
FinanceBot: Reminder: attach final invoice, W9, and ACH details to thread for payment.
Marcus: Thanks all — closing this out.
